analysis:
Examined the doc changes in docs/architecture/inference.md (head lines 2492-2512), the EngineV2KVBackendPolicy.swift paged-list addition (head lines 38-41), the new maskCacheKey/allowsChainedDecode overrides in FlintAnswerStopConstraint.swift (head lines 70-91) and FlintNativeProtocolConstraint.swift (patch hunk at 145), and the mlx-swift-lm submodule bump (f77b384c to f4a297e2).

Flint mask caching and chained decode: the cache key is the interned state ID, or -1 for matched nodes. The stop constraint returns the base key only when it is >=0, and returns nil on resource exhaustion or when remainingTokens<=0. The allowed set therefore depends only on state, and the cache is per-constraint, i.e. per-request, so no cross-tenant or cross-request mask sharing is evident. Key collision between a matched node (-1) and a base key is excluded by the key>=0 guard. The allowedTokenIDs/nextState locking pattern is unchanged. The speculative sampling and redraw logic lives in the submodule engine, which was not supplied, so equivalence with unchained decode is an unverified contract. A wrong mask could only affect output-format constraint enforcement (protocol framing, answer stops), not authentication or encryption. No finding is warranted from the supplied evidence.

Paged backend policy: adding RecursiveSI/flint-int4 to the automatic paged list only changes backend selection for an exact ID. Explicit-selection semantics, the kill switch (DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PAGED_KV) and the crash-loop guard are unchanged. Flint's paged prefix-cache and SSD interaction (T-041) is not changed in the supplied files; it depends on the submodule and on unchanged factory code.

Submodule bump: the pointer moves from f77b384c to f4a297e2 and the contents are not visible. The docs describe fused kernels, a MoE combine and chained decode in the SDK. The changes to the inference engine, sampling, KV cache and memory handling (TB-007, T-028, T-041) cannot be assessed from this patch.

The submodule diff needs a separate pass, specifically for ownership/lifetime of retained logits, device mask caches (growth bounded by constraint states), and per-row RNG restoration.
